Operation Ironhold © 2026 StarKnightt. The single-player Sector 7 game, its
procedural graphics, sound and simulation come from upstream at commit
`93ecc95b826b3a1ae02877c430f19a2276690b74`. See LICENSE (MIT).
https://github.com/StarKnightt/operation-ironhold

pureTV adapts the menus, input and pause lifecycle and bundles the upstream
Three.js r128 dependency locally. The distribution includes the MIT licenses
for the game, Three.js and the pureTV controller bridge in THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt.
